problem: Which of the following gives the coordinates of the minimum point of the function $y=\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x?$
worked_solution:
Let's recall the graph of $y=\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13962359/assets/df22eea4331c47da3047381ca672fd80ebf75118054316fe88c0e2d96dae0d34.png)

From the graph, we see that the minimum of the function is $-\frac{\pi }{2}$ and it is reached at $x=-1.$ Therefore, the coordinates of the minimum point of the function are $(-1,-\frac{\pi }{2}).$
